a01_speaker_label_present.evidence: Several body lines lack labels, e.g. "यह इसके आयाम का वर्ग है।"

a03_speaker_attribution.evidence: The original Luc line "Yes?" is rendered as "कमिल: हाँ?".

b01_target_language.evidence: English source-language material remains repeatedly in the body, such as "साई (psi)", "E स्क्वायर", and "Super-resolution".

b02_no_source_residue.evidence: The translation repeatedly retains English words, for example "साई स्क्वायर (psi squared)" and "बीम (किरण पुंज)".

b05_script_consistency.evidence: Latin-script material recurs in "साई (psi)", "E स्क्वायर", and "NSOM".

c03_no_addition.evidence: The translation repeatedly adds parenthetical glosses not present in the source, such as "बीम (किरण पुंज)" and "रिज़ॉल्यूशन (विभेदन क्षमता)".

c09_dialogue_coherence.evidence: Speaker-label omissions and the misattributed "कमिल: हाँ?" disrupt the intended turn-taking.

d01_standard_terms.evidence: Some technical terms are rendered as unglossed English-derived forms, notably "इवनेसेंट तरंगों" and "साई स्क्वायर".

d03_borrowing_policy.evidence: The translation alternates between loanwords and native equivalents, e.g. "बीम (किरण पुंज)" but later simply "बीम".

d09_gloss_appropriateness.evidence: Repeated parenthetical glosses such as "बीम (किरण पुंज)" and "रिज़ॉल्यूशन (विभेदन क्षमता)" are more extensive than necessary.

e03_syntax.evidence: The phrasing "यह इसके आयाम का वर्ग है" is structurally understandable but awkward in this context.

e05_no_calque.evidence: The phrase "एक ऐसी छवि की बात करना चाहूँगा जिसे... जिसे वास्तव में हर कोई जानता है" closely follows English phrasing and is unnatural in Hindi.

e08_politeness_consistency.evidence: Camille alternates between informal and formal address to Luc: "तुम्हारे क्षेत्र" versus "आप बिल्कुल सही कह रहे हैं".

evaluation.overall_comment: The translation largely preserves the scientific content and conversational flow, with accurate formulas and generally competent Hindi. Its principal defects are recurring missing speaker labels, one clear speaker misattribution, recurrent English/Latin-script residue, and unnecessary parenthetical glosses. A few expressions are calqued or stylistically awkward, and the level of address between the two speakers is inconsistent.
